Onten OTN-5701 USB HUB - Specs

  • Model: OTN-5701
  • Type: 4-Port USB HUB
  • Ports: 1x USB 3.0 + 3x USB 2.0
  • USB 3.0 Speed: 5 Gbps
  • USB 2.0 Speed: 480 Mbps
  • Cable Length: 11-15 cm
  • Dimensions: 80 × 15 × 7 mm
  • Material: Aluminum Alloy
  • Weight: 39g
  • Driver: Plug & Play (No driver needed)
  • Switch: Individual On/Off per port
  • Compatible with: USB 2.0 / 1.1 / 1.0 (Backward compatible)
